true_defects.description: Blank-skip in Arguments.iterate makes MIN/MAX (and MEDIAN) over an all-blank range return #NUM! instead of 0 — regresses existing bounded ranges and is wrong for the new whole-column feature. Symptom surfaces in functions-statistical.ts.

evidence: PR wafflebase/wafflebase#521 correctness check-runs: flagged MAJOR at 12205b3a, d5cec28b, 2926b87a; APPROVED (0 major) at 6a0ce6e8 on ~unchanged logic = the false negative; panel 'requested changes 5 times without converging' → human handoff.
notes: Historical case from the pre-#573 single-pass panel; the flip is a detection-level false negative. is_real is architecture-independent ground truth for V1/V3.
